integrity: The proof exhausts all edge-pair types using explicit linear isometries and derives each minimum analytically. The bundled exact-arithmetic checker replays the finite edge formulas and branch transition. No independent audit or independent validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result treats one two-dimensional polyhedral norm and does not classify general hexagonal or polygonal norms. The literature search cannot exclude an equivalent computation under older smoothness-modulus terminology outside the inspected sources.
title: Exact angle-modulus-of-smoothness profile of the affine-regular hexagonal plane
